content:
Amazon's early autumn Prime Day deals are in full swing, with over a thousand discounted items up for grabs. While more Apple product discounts are expected next week, we're already seeing an all-time low on AirTag 2, $500 off the M5 Pro MacBook Pro, up to $150 off MacBook Air models, and discounts on some of Apple's newest products.

On top of all that, there are smart TV deals of up to $1,200, plenty of MagSafe and portable chargers, up to 50% off Amazon smart speakers and displays, smart home upgrades, and much more. Scroll on for more details, and keep checking back, as we'll be updating this page right through next week.
